name: React Router (Remix)
subtitle: React framework (Remix merged into React Router v7)
creator: Michael Jackson and Ryan Florence
description: The most widely used React routing library, which in v7 absorbed the Remix framework. In framework mode it adds server rendering, data loaders and form actions built on web standards like Request, Response and HTML forms.
useCases: Apps that lean on forms and progressive enhancement

concepts.explanation: Server functions that fetch data before render.
Server functions that handle form submissions.
Forms work even before JavaScript loads.

Huge existing React Router user base
